color.name: Color and Composition
color.v1_3_note: Renamed from 'Color: Perception, Not Physics'. As of spine v1.3, this sequence absorbs the composition study and is sourced from three auto-research galleries: primitive-stack, pattern, and facade. 2026-08-24 THE FOLD: array_tutorial collapses into this sequence — Color_Arrays is the whole array grammar in one map (1d unit, row, column, 2d grid, 3d grid and the sorting arrays in the last basin), built on the Array map's own three-pool structure. The pattern work of Tutorial_Pattern / Array_Patterns joins Pattern_Foundry.

color.truth: Color is perception, not physics. RGB is a lie we agree on. What you see depends on context, not wavelength alone.
color.qfep_connection: Color is a system stateâ€”part of the S term in QFEP. But unlike vectors, color is fundamentally perceptual: the same wavelength can appear different colors depending on surrounding context. Color reveals the gap between ontology (photons) and experience (qualia).

color.description: The physics and perception of color. Light has wavelength, but color is what brains make of it. Explore RGB, HSV, and the gap between objective light and subjective experience.
learning_objectives: RGB color space: additive mixing of red, green, blue
HSV color space: hue, saturation, valueâ€”more intuitive
Perception theory: color constancy, simultaneous contrast
Digital materiality: how screens create color

Color as function: every gradient is a function from t ∈ [0,1] to a color. Color is your first encounter with a continuous mapping — the move that sets up wavefunctions (functions of time) and forces (vector-valued functions of position) as already-familiar.
color.deferred_reason: Removed from active sequence to tighten progression. Color_Context is a 30-artifact showcase map â€” potential future standalone or advanced color sequence.

artifact_groups.rationale: Nail salon studio: precise color selection on a digital body. Introduces color as interaction.
Grid becomes canvas: systematic color assignment cell by cell with spectrum visualization.
Walking through light: spectrum progression with animated rainbow emitters along a corridor.
Pillar gauntlet: color collection, mixing, and spectrum analysis in a columned runway.
Action painting studio: gestural color application meets structured Albers color studies.
Gradient environment: continuous color transitions dissolving categorical boundaries.
MultiMesh color cycling test: pattern progression through flashlight interaction. Synthesis of color systems.

taxonomy._readme: THE LADDER (2026-08-24). FOUR rungs, not five: the UNIT is not taught here. Palle: 'we have worked with them before in earlier sequences and we can go right on the index.' The spine agrees — primitives is sequence 1 (points, lines, planes, 73 artifacts) and color is 4, so the cube, the sphere and the polyhedron arrive already known. The unit is a THRESHOLD the walk crosses, not a room it stops in. Closes as a LOOP: composition returns to the unit and shows it was never neutral (Albers: no two adjacent squares look the way they would alone).
taxonomy.2_index: how do I address many? — row, column, 2d grid, 3d grid, bar arrays, sorting. THE ROOM IS Array itself: measured 6 index to 2 unit, index-pure, and the spine already names array_tutorial 'the grid, indexing, addressable repetition'. Color_Arrays (a twin built the same day) is retired into it.
taxonomy.3_attribute: what does a unit carry? — spectrum, gradient, colour space, mixing
taxonomy.4_rule: how does an attribute REPEAT across an index? — tiles, looms, mills, the wallpaper groups (Pattern_Foundry). REPETITION ONLY.
taxonomy.5_composition: when does the rule become a made thing? — Albers, Mondrian, Rothko, the colour stacks, the furniture, and the primitive stack as the recapitulation
taxonomy._generation_comes_later: Palle, 2026-08-24: grammar, CA and factories — a rule that MAKES rules — are downstream, not here. crackpropagation_ca -> biological_growth, csg_architecture_cavity -> boolean_surfaces, constraint_sculptor -> gallery (all removed; each already placed there). STILL HERE for want of a home: pattern_tunnel_machine, brick_wall_factory — they exist nowhere else in the corpus, and orphaning an artifact to tidy a taxonomy is the worse error.
taxonomy.0_unit_recalled: carried from primitives (spine 1) — pick_up_cube, xyz_coordinates and the synthesis stand appear as recall beats inside the index room, never as a rung of their own
